vision_findings.vs1_main_basic:
**QA review — mostly clean, a few minor issues (no blocking bugs)**

**(1) Overlapping / clipped UI**
- No true overlaps or clipping in the chrome. The right-side zoom/rotate stack clears the bottom toolbar by a small but adequate margin; "Dig Down" and the compass fit within the viewport.
- Minor: the left sidebar's "Patios & Paths" list is cut mid-item ("Patio" and a sliver of the next item are clipped at the status bar). Normal scroll behavior, but ending on a half-rendered row looks slightly unfinished — a fade or padding would help.

**(2) 5-second comprehension — yes**
- Clear hierarchy: "ADD TO YOUR YARD" palette on the left, big 3D canvas in the middle, view modes up top, tools along the bottom. The "Getting Started" callout explicitly explains the add-then-drag model. A new user would get it.

**(3) Confusing / ambiguous items**
- **"Innovate"** (bottom toolbar, pin icon) — reads like a typo, likely meant to be "Irrigate." A pin icon doesn't match "Innovate" either way. Most suspicious item on screen. *(medium)*
- **Duplicate "Terrain" controls** — "Terrain" appears both in the floating bottom-left card and in the bottom toolbar with a different icon. Unclear whether they do the same thing. *(medium)*
- **"Dig Down"** is the only icon-less button in the bottom row, set apart by a gap — reads as intentional grouping but looks slightly detached/unstyled next to its icon-labeled neighbors. *(low)*
- The blue grid surrounding the green terrain reads as "water" at first glance — a new user may think the yard floats in a pool. A legend or different surrounding color would remove the ambiguity. *(low)*
- "FPS: —" in the status bar is empty at startup; fine, but consider hiding until measured. *(nit)*

**Summary:** Solid, understandable layout with no layout bugs; fix the probable "Innovate"→"Irrigate" typo and clarify the duplicate Terrain controls before ship.
vision_findings.vs2_sidebar_advanced:
CLEAN — The editor reads instantly (brand + Basic/Advanced toggle top-left, item palette on the left, 3D canvas with floating Sculpt/Build/View panel, labeled action bar and status strip at the bottom), with no overlapping, clipped, or misaligned elements.

Minor non-blocking nit only: the red compass needle at top-right slightly overhangs the dial edge (~1205,130) — reads as a stylistic pointer rather than a defect.
vision_findings.vs3_toolbar_panel_basic: **CLEAN** — No overlapping or clipped UI found: the floating Terrain Sculpting panel, compass, zoom controls, bottom toolbar, and status bar are all well-spaced and fully visible; the helpful on-panel hint ("Pick a mode, then click + drag on the ground to sculpt"), labeled tool groups, and clear active-state highlights make the screen understandable within seconds.
vision_findings.vs4_underground_advanced:
**QA Results — issues found (not CLEAN)**

**(1) Overlapping / clipped UI:**
- **Right-side vertical toolbar (zoom/controls stack):** the fourth button below the reset/refresh button is **clipped by the status bar** — only a sliver of the button and icon is visible (~x1230, y740). Looks broken.
- **Minor:** the "Patio" item at the bottom of the left sidebar is cut off mid-row. Acceptable if the list scrolls, but at first glance it reads as a rendering clip.

**(2) 5-second comprehension:**
- Mostly yes. The left "Add to your yard" panel, 3D viewport, and toolbars are conventional. The "Underground view active — Cutaway/Opacity below reveal the layers" banner is a nice touch and explains the unusual wireframe terrain.
- **However**, landing a brand-new user directly in Underground/Excavate mode (wireframe cutaway terrain) is an odd default state — the scene looks "unfinished/broken" until they read the banner. A default to normal terrain view would be friendlier.

**(3) Confusing / ambiguous / misplaced:**
- The clipped right-edge button (issue #1) is the main "broken-looking" element.
- "Innovate" as a bottom-toolbar button label is vague — unclear what it does without a tooltip.
- The "Underground" rail item and its flyout panel visually merge into one green mass; a slight separation or connector would make the panel's parent clearer (very minor).
- Everything else (compass, Take Tour, Daytime pill, scale bar, status bar) is placed sensibly with no overlaps.

**Summary:** One real defect — the clipped fourth button in the right-side control stack — plus minor polish items (defaulting to Excavate mode, vague "Innovate" label); fix the clip and this screen is essentially clean.
vision_findings.vs5_help_modal_basic:
**QA Findings — mostly clean, a few minor notes**

**1) Overlapping / clipped UI**
- No blocking overlaps. Modal, toolbar, zoom controls, compass, and top bar all have clear separation.
- Minor: the "Patio" item at the bottom of the left sidebar is clipped mid-item. This looks like normal scroll behavior, but the tiny gray sliver of its icon below reads slightly broken at first glance.

**2) 5-second comprehension**
- Yes. The onboarding modal states the core loop explicitly (click item → place → adjust), the left panel is labeled "ADD TO YOUR YARD," and the canvas is an obvious 3D grid. A new user would get it immediately.

**3) Confusing / ambiguous / broken-looking**
- **Content inconsistency (most notable):** The modal says Basic mode shows only "Terrain sculpting, Sun & Shadow, and core object placement," with excavation/analysis tools reserved for Advanced — yet the bottom toolbar in Basic mode shows **Excavate, Dig Down, Analyze, and Innovate**. Either those buttons should be hidden/dimmed in Basic, or the help text is inaccurate.
- **Possible duplicate controls:** Both "Sun & Shadow" and "Sun" appear in the bottom toolbar — ambiguous whether they're the same feature or two different ones.
- **Minor inconsistency:** "Load" in the top bar has no icon, while Save, Capture, Shortcuts, and Help all do.
- Everything else (toggles, undo/redo, scale bar, status bar, "Take Tour") looks correct and consistent.

**Verdict:** Near-clean — no visual bugs or overlaps, but fix the Basic-mode toolbar vs. help-text contradiction and the Load icon for polish.
vision_findings.vs6_shortcuts_basic:
**QA findings — not quite CLEAN:**

1. **Clipped control, top-right header (x≈1269, y≈27):** a chevron/overflow button (›) is cut in half by the right viewport edge. Looks broken; either give it breathing room or widen the header container. *(Low severity, but it's the only visibly clipped element.)*

2. **Duplicate "Terrain" labels in bottom toolbars:** "Terrain" appears both as a dock toggle (bottom-left, behind the modal) and as a toolbar button mid-right. A new user can't tell if these are the same control. *(Minor ambiguity.)*

3. **"Cycle placed objects → Alt+Tab":** Alt+Tab is hijacked by the OS (window switching on Windows/macOS), so this shortcut will feel broken in practice. Consider remapping (e.g., Tab or [ ]). *(Functional concern, not visual.)*

**Non-issues (checked and fine):** the modal correctly overlays the Terrain/Sun & Shadow dock buttons; the left palette's clipped "Patio" row is normal scroll behavior; compass, Take Tour, zoom controls, scale bar, and status bar don't collide; modal content is well-organized with clear "Got it!" dismissal.

**5-second comprehension:** Yes — the app identity, tool palette, and the fact that a shortcuts guide is open are all immediately clear.

**Verdict:** Minor fixes needed — the clipped chevron is the only true visual defect.
